gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(df, geometry=geometry, crs="EPSG:4326")
gdf = gdf.to_crs(epsg=3857)

gdf['Gentrificated'] = gdf['Gentrificated'].fillna(False).astype(bool)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 10))

g1 = gdf[gdf['Gentrificated']].plot(ax=ax, color='red', markersize=1, alpha=0.5, label='Gentrified')
g2 = gdf[~gdf['Gentrificated']].plot(ax=ax, color='blue', markersize=1, alpha=0.5, label='Not Gentrified')

ctx.add_basemap(ax, source=ctx.providers.OpenStreetMap.Mapnik)

ax.set_title('London Gentrification Map (2010s vs 2020s)', fontsize=14)
ax.legend(loc='lower right', markerscale=10)  # Adjust location and size as needed
plt.axis('off')
plt.show()

In [125]:
gbm_models = {}
X_by_gen = {}

for gen in df['Gentrificated'].unique():
    print(f'\n Training GBM for Group {gen}')
    
    df_gen = df[df['Gentrificated'] == gen].dropna()
    
    X = df_gen.drop(drop_cols + [target_col], axis=1)
    X = pd.get_dummies(X, drop_first=True)
    y = df_gen[target_col]
    
    X_by_gen[gen] = X.copy()
    
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)
    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X_scaled, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)
    
    gbm = GradientBoostingRegressor(n_estimators=100, max_depth=3, learning_rate=0.1, random_state=42)
    gbm.fit(X_train, y_train)
    
    gbm_models[gen] = gbm
    
    y_pred = gbm.predict(X_test)
    rmse = mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred, squared=False)
    r2 = r2_score(y_test, y_pred)
    
    print(f'RMSE: {rmse:.2f}')
    print(f'R²: {r2:.2f}')

# 변수 중요도 비교 

for gen, gbm in gbm_models.items():
    X_gen = X_by_gen[gen]
    feature_names = X_gen.columns
    importances = gbm.feature_importances_
    
    top_indices = np.argsort(importances)[::-1][:10]

    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
    x = np.arange(len(top_indices))
    plt.bar(x, importances[top_indices])
    plt.xticks(x, feature_names[top_indices], rotation=45, ha='right')
    plt.ylabel('Feature Importance')
    plt.title(f'Feature Importance (Group {gen})')
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
    
    top_features = [(feature_names[i], importances[i]) for i in top_indices]
    print(f"\nTop 10 Features for Group {gen}:")
    for name, score in top_features:
        print(f"{name}: {score:.4f}")
